metadata.description: Data and tools for your AI agent: hundreds of data tasks from one catalog, paid per call from a prepaid balance.

plugins.name: ahel
plugins.description: Company and people enrichment, SEO and SERP data, social media data, official EU business registers and more, through one MCP connection. Pay per call, price shown before each run.

plugins.name: find-work-emails
plugins.description: Use when the user has a list of people (name + company domain, or a LinkedIn URL) and wants their work emails found and verified, as a CSV with a status per row and the total cost. Quotes the price first. Needs the ahel plugin.

plugins.name: eu-company-check
plugins.description: Use when the user wants to check EU companies by name and country or registry code: official register record and status, LEI and a sanctions screen, as a sourced table with the total cost. Estonia, Finland, Norway, Latvia, Ireland, France. Needs the ahel plugin.

plugins.name: lead-signals
plugins.description: Use when the user wants companies, buyers and topics watched once a day with only new signals reported: new EU tenders (TED), official business-register changes and possible sanctions matches, each with its source URL and run id. Keeps a local seen set; runs on a schedule. Needs the ahel plugin.
